practiceQuestions: Q2. Key formula for M,P Errors.
formulas: Maximum fractional error: for $Z = AB$ or $Z = A/B$, $\frac{\Delta Z}{Z} = \frac{\Delta A}{A} + \frac{\Delta B}{B}$.
For $Z = A^n B^m / C^p$, $\frac{\Delta Z}{Z} = n\frac{\Delta A}{A} + m\frac{\Delta B}{B} + p\frac{\Delta C}{C}$.
keyPoints: Errors always ADD, never cancel: a quotient of two measured quantities is no more precise than the worse of the two.
